Registry bytes and first expected posting pairings copied verbatim from Hawala PR #50 commit `995a37d40ce57a386d4004cd6dbb656fe2191360`, file `formal/evidence/node-books-accounting-v1.json`. Original fixture was independently Python-encoded and its pairings independently hand specified. These fixtures preserve registry bytes and pairings, not the old PostgreSQL-first financial semantics or event-reference metadata. The native test translates first-transfer ID 1000 to the immutable operation anchor; epoch/count/index occupy the TB-first metadata fields.
